intro: Our holiday intensive program runs on the first week of each school holiday (dates vary for the summer break): January, April, July, September.
intensiveIntro: Content ranges from both revision of past topics to a head start on new topics 1–2 terms ahead of the pacing at typical high schools.
mockExams: 5 sets of timed, supervised exams with hand-crafted papers. Each exam will be critically marked and accompanied by a tutorial session.
